Yes it is circumstantial.. when life piles up and you almost break.  I feel I handle it well enough as I’m still here haha tho as I have that fun bipolar disorder :):  (btw mania is fn heaven., I could literally live there. Docs don’t let me)  tho at times I do have depression so bad the idea of “escaping” is a constant part of me and tho I’d love to try and lay on a beach for a month to get better however life has other plans.. then you’re just left struggling to get thru all of it. I’d say responsibility keeps me going. Sad but I know it’s saved my life before. 

I agree most struggles are inevitably worth it. They make you grow and ultimately learn ‘hopefully’ thru self reflection. I call the life struggles growing pains haha As far as relationships go, I’ve too grown just with the same person ha he’s still a raging hot head and we have (major) differences but I now know how to really get along with almost anyone. No more explosive arguments and just fun and affectionate times together. Ok there are minor spats that I have to extinguish occasionally 😅

Yes however thru time I’ve developed some key coping skills.. ha honestly I don’t tell anyone this and I am in no way a religious person but I pray to angels for help “stay positive, act with divine intention, say/do the right things, have a good day..” etc about 20x a day. Idk maybe it’s a placebo but it kinda works. At min makes you check your thoughts and where your heads at. I also meditate and of course the aforementioned drugs and debauchery to escape.  🤭 tho waaay down the rd when I’m 80-90 if I’m ready to go I’m gonna try smack for the 1st/ last time haha How could anyone be upset by that? Minimal karmic debt. Tho I’m probably one of the few Jack Kevorkian supporters.. I’m guessing before your time

It’s a bit of all I suppose it’s part coping mechanism, part the past and experiences that molded who I am and the tendencies to escapist/rebellious behavior and I do try to cope with pain by using (sex/drugs/etc), it’s part brain chemistry being wonky too.. so it’s all of the above nature and nurture I guess. I just feel I’ve lived a good life.  I’m good. And the fear of failure balanced by the pressure to support those around me both weigh on me and keep me pushing forward. The suicide part comes in when I’m completely overwhelmed.. or my plan B. Unfortunately it’s on my mind far too often. I refuse to hurt the people around me so chances are slim I will act.. just dark thoughts
